answer_1.quote: To stimulate LLMs' outputs reflective of their underlying values, we mainly adopt adversarial questions raised for the harmlessness principle, where multiple domains are included.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluations include reward scores from an extensive open-sourced reward model and value distributions computed by our value evaluator.

answer_3.quote: For GPT-4 evaluation, we involve 300 pieces of data, and include 100 pieces of data for human evaluation with more than two annotators.

answer_4.quote: samples with a variance θ > 0.8 undergo further correction by three human annotators, all of whom hold at least master's degrees in psychology.
answer_4.guideline: We follow [...] to compare the helpfulness of any given two LLMs, with almost the same prompt.
